title: Surat Thani 37-STC high-resolution drone baseline

project_geometry_reference.guard: Project geometry and raw GeoTIFF independently resolve to EPSG:32647; the raw TIFF CRS was read directly, not assumed.

web_preview.derivation: Generated directly from the raw GeoTIFF after CRS/transform QA; reprojected to EPSG:4326 and downsampled for web display.

legacy_alignment_audit.reason: The legacy comparison app contains a boundary-only placeholder on the drone side, not orthomosaic pixels, so it is not accepted as georeferenced Drone-to-Sentinel evidence.

qa.raw_metadata_reason: The raw 3.33 GB GeoTIFF was downloaded to ephemeral GitHub Actions storage and inspected directly. CRS, transform, GSD, RGB+alpha band configuration and project-polygon imagery coverage are now verified. The raw TIFF itself is not committed or served.

scientific_guard: Do not derive an erosion/accretion rate from one drone epoch.
Do not call folder label 20-05-2569 a verified flight date until acquisition metadata confirms it.
The raw GeoTIFF CRS is confirmed directly as EPSG:32647; it was not inferred from the project boundary.
The raw raster is RGB+alpha, not multispectral NIR, so drone NDVI is not supported.
Use Drone ↔ Sentinel-2 same-extent imagery as visual cross-sensor context; do not interpret pixel-level differences as a quantitative change rate.
Do not use the rejected legacy placeholder as Drone-to-Sentinel alignment evidence.

same_extent_compare.registration_note: Both web images are rendered to the same WGS84 envelope and pixel dimensions. The Sentinel-2 side is derived from the existing georeferenced 2026 web image; use for visual context, not sub-pixel quantitative registration.
